description:
Based in the heart of Silicon Valley, AI Aspire is Dr. Andrew Ng's advisory firm guiding enterprises through their AI transformation journeys. The firm is led day-to-day by its Managing Partner Kirsty Tan, whose deep enterprise consulting experience brings fresh leadership to the firm's mission of helping large organizations harness the power of AI. Our mission is to reshape global industry with AI, helping enterprises become the AI-native leaders of their industries - delivering real impact through integrity, expertise, and adaptability.
Through AI Aspire, Dr. Ng continues to leverage the flywheel effect of his broader ecosystem, including AI Fund and DeepLearning.AI, to accelerate responsible and effective AI adoption across industries.

About the Role
 
 We are looking for Forward Deployed AI Engineers to join our team and work directly at the intersection of AI engineering and enterprise impact. In this role, you will be embedded with our enterprise clients to help them identify high-value opportunities, redesign workflows, and implement AI-powered solutions that drive real business outcomes. Between client engagements, you will be based out of our Mountain View office, contributing to internal tooling and platform development.

 This is a unique and dynamic role that blends deep technical AI engineering with meaningful client-facing work. You are not just building in isolation — you are translating cutting-edge AI capabilities into practical solutions for some of the world's leading organizations. To thrive here, you will need to be both a strong engineer and someone who can communicate clearly with business stakeholders, understand their challenges, and earn their trust.



Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Deploy to enterprise client sites for short-term engagements to assess AI opportunities, redesign workflows, and implement AI-powered solutions



 
 Work closely with client teams to understand their business processes, identify inefficiencies, and design AI solutions that drive meaningful impact



 
 Build and deploy AI tools, agents, and automations using the latest models and frameworks



 
 Collaborate with engagement managers and leadership to ensure client engagements are scoped, planned, and delivered effectively



 
 Contribute to internal platform and tooling development between client engagements



 
 Stay current with the latest developments in AI engineering and bring new ideas and approaches back to the team






What We Are Looking For
 

 
 Strong AI engineering skills — you are proficient building with LLMs, agents, RAG systems, and related technologies



 
 Hands-on experience with tools including Claude Code, Codex, and related AI-assisted development tools



 
 Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical business stakeholders



 
 Comfortable with client-facing work and able to navigate enterprise environments professionally



 
 Willingness to travel for short-term client engagements (1-3 weeks at a time)



 
 Problem-solver with a bias for action — you figure things out and get things done



 
 Experience with enterprise software, APIs, and system integrations






Nice to Have
 

 
 Background in financial services, consulting, or other professional services



 
 Prior experience in a forward deployed, consulting, or solutions engineering role
